naam: Zijwaarts rekken met arm boven het hoofd – staand
pose_en: She stands upright, seen from the FRONT, feet shoulder-width apart. Her left hand rests on her left hip. Her right arm is raised straight up above her head, close to her right ear. The arrow is a long curved arrow starting at her right hand and arcing over her head toward HER LEFT side (the viewer's right), showing the trunk and the raised arm bending sideways.
eind_en: END position: seen from the front, her trunk is bent clearly sideways to HER LEFT (the viewer's right), the straight right arm reaching over her head toward the left, the left hand still on the left hip, the hips pushed a little to her right; both feet flat on the floor, no forward bend, no twisting.
extra_avatar: Both figures seen exactly from the front. TOP: upright, right arm straight up beside the ear, left hand on the hip. BOTTOM: a big, obvious sideways bend to her left (viewer's right) forming a long curve from the right hip to the right hand; she does not lean forward.

pose_en: She lies on her back on an exercise mat, seen exactly from the side, head to the left. Her knees are bent, feet flat on the mat hip-width apart, and her hips are LIFTED in a bridge so the body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees; arms flat on the mat beside her body. The arrow is a curved arrow at the knee nearest the viewer pointing UP toward her chest, showing that foot lifting off the mat while the hips stay up.
eind_en: END position: hips still lifted in the bridge and level; one foot stays flat on the mat, the leg nearest the viewer is lifted with the knee bent 90 degrees and the thigh pointing up to the ceiling, foot in the air (a marching step).
extra_avatar: Seen exactly from the side. In BOTH figures the hips stay HIGH in a bridge. TOP: both feet on the mat. BOTTOM: the near foot clearly lifted, thigh vertical, knee bent 90 degrees; the hips do not drop.

naam: Hoofd en armen draaien met armen zijwaarts – zittend
pose_en: Frame her from the hips up. She sits upright on a chair, seen from the FRONT. Both arms are straight and raised out to the sides to exactly shoulder height (a T-shape), hands open, both thumbs pointing UP to the ceiling. She looks straight ahead. The arrow is a curved arrow just above her head pointing toward HER RIGHT (the viewer's left), showing the head turning to look at the right hand.
eind_en: END position: seen from the front, both arms still straight out to the sides at shoulder height; her head is turned to HER RIGHT to look at her right hand; the right hand is rotated so its thumb points up and backward, the left hand is turned over so its thumb points DOWN to the floor.
extra_avatar: Frame both figures from the hips up, seen from the front, both arms in a clear T-shape at shoulder height in BOTH figures. TOP: head facing forward, both thumbs up. BOTTOM: head clearly turned to look at her right hand; right thumb up and back, left hand turned over with the thumb pointing down. The head turn and the hand rotation must be obvious.

naam: Arm heffen – op handen en knieën
pose_en: She is on her hands and knees on an exercise mat, seen exactly from the side, facing left: hands directly under the shoulders, knees under the hips, back flat like a table top, head in line with the spine, looking at the floor. The arrow is a curved arrow at the hand nearest the viewer going FORWARD and UP, showing that straight arm lifting forward to shoulder height.
eind_en: END position: the arm nearest the viewer is straight and raised forward to shoulder height, in line with the back, thumb up; the other hand and both knees stay on the mat, the back stays flat and the hips stay level. Both legs stay on the mat.
extra_avatar: Seen exactly from the side. ONLY one arm moves; both knees and both shins stay on the mat in BOTH figures (do NOT lift a leg). BOTTOM: the near arm is straight forward at shoulder height.

naam: Bekken kantelen met benen in tafelhouding – liggend
pose_en: CLOSE-UP: frame her from the chest down to the feet, seen exactly from the side, head to the left. She lies on her back on an exercise mat with BOTH legs lifted in a 'table top' position: hips bent 90 degrees, knees bent 90 degrees, shins horizontal and parallel to the floor, feet in the air; a small rolled towel is held between the knees; arms flat on the mat. There is a small visible hollow under her lower back. The arrow is a short curved arrow at her tailbone pointing UP and toward her knees, showing the pelvis tilting backward so the lower back flattens.
eind_en: END position: same table-top legs; the pelvis is tilted backward so the tailbone curls a few centimetres up off the mat and the lower back is pressed flat into the mat; the knees come slightly closer to the chest.
extra_avatar: CLOSE-UP framing from the chest to the feet, exactly from the side. TOP: table-top legs, buttocks flat on the mat and a clear hollow under the lower back. BOTTOM: the tailbone clearly curled up off the mat, the lower back flat, the knees slightly closer to the chest. Exaggerate the difference.

naam: Brug – met bal tussen de knieën
pose_en: She lies on her back on an exercise mat, seen from the side at a slight three-quarter angle from above, head to the left, so that a small soft ball (about 20 cm) squeezed BETWEEN HER KNEES is clearly visible. Knees bent, feet flat on the mat hip-width apart, arms flat beside her body, hips resting on the mat. The arrow is a curved arrow under her hips pointing UP, showing the hips lifting.
eind_en: END position: same view, the hips are lifted so the body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees, the ball still clearly squeezed between the knees, feet flat, arms on the mat.
extra_avatar: The ball between the knees must be clearly visible in BOTH figures. TOP: hips on the mat. BOTTOM: hips high, straight line from shoulders to knees.

pose_en: She lies on her back on an exercise mat, seen from her FEET end and slightly from above, so both knees point toward the viewer and her head is at the far end of the mat. Both knees are bent, feet flat on the mat hip-width apart, arms flat beside her body. The arrow is a curved arrow at her right knee (on the viewer's left) arcing OUTWARD and DOWN toward the mat, showing the knee dropping out to the side.
eind_en: END position: same view; the right knee has dropped out to the side toward the mat, the sole of the right foot turned inward, the left knee still points straight up, the pelvis stays flat on the mat.
extra_avatar: Both figures seen from the foot end, slightly from above. TOP: both knees up. BOTTOM: only the right knee has dropped far out to the side; the left knee stays upright; the pelvis does not roll.

pose_en: She lies on her RIGHT side on an exercise mat, seen from the FRONT (her face and chest toward the viewer), head on the viewer's left. She supports herself on her right forearm, the elbow directly under the shoulder. Her knees are bent about 90 degrees with the feet behind her, and her hips are LIFTED off the mat so the body forms a straight line from the knees to the head. Her left hand rests on her left hip. Draw a short straight arrow under her lifted hip pointing UP, showing the hips being held up.
eind_en: She holds this position: on the right forearm, knees bent and resting on the mat, hips lifted so the body is a straight line from knees to head, left hand on the hip, head in line with the body.
extra_avatar: Seen from the front, the straight line from knees to head clearly visible, the hips clearly off the mat, the knees (not the feet) are the lower support point.

naam: Armen omhoog langs de mat – liggend
pose_en: She lies on her back on an exercise mat, seen from directly ABOVE (bird's-eye view), head at the top of the image. Knees bent, feet flat. Both arms lie flat on the mat in a 'W' shape: upper arms out to the sides, elbows bent 90 degrees and pulled down toward her waist, forearms pointing up toward her head, the backs of the hands and the elbows touching the mat. The arrow is a long straight arrow beside her right hand pointing UP along the mat toward the top of the image, showing the arms sliding up overhead.
eind_en: END position: same view from above; both arms have slid up along the mat into a 'Y' shape above her head, elbows only slightly bent, the elbows and the backs of the wrists still touching the mat; the lower back stays on the mat.
extra_avatar: Both figures seen from directly above. TOP: arms in a W-shape, elbows near the waist. BOTTOM: arms slid up into a Y-shape above the head, still flat on the mat.

naam: Bekkenbodem en diepe buik aanspannen – staand
pose_en: CLOSE-UP: frame her from the chest down to the knees, seen exactly from the side, facing left. She stands upright, feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent, pelvis in a neutral middle position. Her near hand rests flat on her lower belly below the navel, her other hand rests on her lower back. Draw a short straight arrow at her lower belly pointing BACKWARD (inward toward the spine), showing the lower belly drawing gently in.
eind_en: She holds this position: standing with the knees slightly bent, the lower belly gently drawn in under her hand, the back in a neutral position, shoulders relaxed, breathing calmly.
extra_avatar: Frame her from the chest down to the knees, exactly from the side; the hand on the lower belly and the hand on the lower back clearly visible; knees slightly bent.

naam: Benen op de bal opzij rollen – liggend
pose_en: She lies on her back on an exercise mat, seen from directly ABOVE (bird's-eye view), head at the top of the image. Her legs are straight and together, the calves resting on top of a large exercise ball; her arms are crossed over her chest, shoulders flat on the mat. The arrow is a curved arrow beside the ball pointing toward HER RIGHT side, showing the legs rolling the ball sideways.
eind_en: END position: same view from above; the legs and the ball have rolled to HER RIGHT, the pelvis turned along with them, the shoulders and crossed arms still flat on the mat.
extra_avatar: Both figures seen from directly above. TOP: legs and ball in the middle, in line with the body. BOTTOM: legs and ball clearly rolled to her right side, the shoulders stay flat.

pose_en: Frame her from the chest up. She sits upright on a chair, seen from the FRONT. A rolled towel lies around the BACK of her neck; its two ends cross over in front of her throat. Her right hand holds the end that comes from the left side of her neck, her left hand holds the end that comes from the right side, both hands in front of her chest. She looks straight ahead. The arrow is a curved arrow beside her chin pointing toward HER RIGHT (the viewer's left), showing the head turning to the right.
eind_en: END position: seen from the front, her head is turned to HER RIGHT; her right hand has pulled its towel end forward and to the right, following the turn; the left hand stays still in front of her chest.
extra_avatar: Frame both figures from the chest up, seen from the front. The rolled towel around the back of the neck with the ends crossed in front of the throat must be clearly visible in BOTH figures. TOP: head straight. BOTTOM: head clearly turned to her right.

pose_en: Frame her from the waist up, seen from directly ABOVE (bird's-eye view). She lies on her back on an exercise mat, her head resting on a small folded towel, her face pointing straight up to the ceiling, arms beside her body, shoulders flat. The arrow is a curved arrow beside her chin pointing toward HER RIGHT shoulder, showing the head rolling to look over the right shoulder.
eind_en: END position: same view from above; her head is turned to HER RIGHT so she looks over her right shoulder, the back of the head stays on the towel, the shoulders stay flat on the mat.
extra_avatar: CLOSE-UP from the waist up, seen from directly above. TOP: face looks straight up. BOTTOM: the head is turned far to her right, the cheek almost on the towel, the shoulders do not move. Exaggerate the turn.

pose_en: She stands upright, seen exactly from the side, facing left, feet hip-width apart, legs straight. Both hands rest flat on the front of her thighs. The arrow is a long curved arrow from her hands going DOWN along the front of her legs toward her shins, showing the hands sliding down as the trunk bends forward.
eind_en: END position: the trunk is bent forward and down with a rounded back, the hands have slid down the front of the legs to the shins, the knees stay straight, the head hangs relaxed.
extra_avatar: Seen exactly from the side. BOTTOM: a clear forward bend with a rounded back, hands at shin height, knees straight.

pose_en: She lies on her back on an exercise mat, seen exactly from the side, head to the left, knees bent, feet flat. Her far hand rests on her lower ribs. The arm nearest the viewer lies straight on the mat beside her body. The arrow is a curved arrow at the near hand going UP in an arc, showing the straight arm rising until it points to the ceiling.
eind_en: END position: the near arm is straight and points vertically up to the ceiling; the far hand still rests on the lower ribs; the back and the ribs stay down on the mat, the shoulders relaxed.
extra_avatar: Seen exactly from the side. TOP: near arm flat beside the body. BOTTOM: near arm straight up to the ceiling; the hand on the ribs visible in both figures.

naam: Been optillen met gebogen knie – liggend
pose_en: She lies on her back on an exercise mat, seen exactly from the side, head to the left, both knees bent and both feet flat on the mat, arms flat beside her body. The arrow is a curved arrow at the knee nearest the viewer pointing UP and toward her belly, showing that leg lifting with the knee staying bent.
eind_en: END position: the leg nearest the viewer is lifted with the knee still bent 90 degrees, the thigh pointing straight up and the shin horizontal (table-top); the other foot stays flat on the mat; the back stays flat.
extra_avatar: Seen exactly from the side. BOTTOM: one leg in table-top (thigh vertical, shin horizontal), the other foot still on the mat; no bridge, the hips stay on the mat.

pose_en: Frame her from the chest up. She sits upright on a chair, seen exactly from the side, facing left. An elastic band lies across her FOREHEAD; both ends run backward past her ears to her hands, which hold the ends behind her head at neck height, elbows pointing out to the sides. Her head is straight, looking ahead. The arrow is a curved arrow at her chin pointing DOWN toward her chest, showing the head bending forward.
eind_en: END position: same view; her head is bent forward with the chin close to the chest, looking down at her lap; the band over the forehead is stretched back to her hands behind her head.
extra_avatar: CLOSE-UP from the chest up, exactly from the side. The band across the forehead and the hands behind the head clearly visible in BOTH figures. TOP: head straight. BOTTOM: chin clearly down on the chest. Exaggerate the difference.

pose_en: Frame her from the chest up. She sits upright on a chair, seen exactly from the side, facing left. An elastic band goes around the BACK of her head at the base of the skull, with a small folded towel between the band and her head; both ends run forward to her hands, held together in front of her chest, elbows bent, the band slightly taut. She looks straight ahead. The arrow is a curved arrow at the back of her head pointing BACKWARD and DOWN, showing the head tilting back.
eind_en: END position: same view; her head is tilted back so she looks up at the ceiling; the band is stretched from the back of her head to her hands, which stay in front of her chest.
extra_avatar: CLOSE-UP from the chest up, exactly from the side. The band from the back of the head to the hands in front clearly visible in BOTH figures. TOP: looking straight ahead. BOTTOM: head clearly tilted back, looking at the ceiling. Exaggerate the difference.

pose_en: She lies on her back on an exercise mat, seen in a THREE-QUARTER view from her side and slightly from her feet, head away from the viewer on the left. Knees bent, feet flat. An elastic band is anchored to a fixed point at floor level just beyond the top of her head. Her right hand holds the band beside her right ear, elbow bent, the band taut back to the anchor; the left arm rests on the mat. Head and shoulders on the mat, chin slightly tucked. The arrow is a curved arrow from her right hand going FORWARD and diagonally ACROSS her body toward her LEFT knee.
eind_en: END position: head and shoulders curled up off the mat and the upper body turned to the left; the right hand, still holding the band, reaches diagonally past the outside of the left knee; chin tucked; the band stretched back to the anchor behind her head; the lower back stays on the mat.
extra_avatar: BOTTOM: the shoulder blades clearly off the mat, the trunk visibly rotated, the right hand next to the left knee; the band clearly stretched from the hand back to the anchor behind her head.

pose_en: She sits upright on a plain chair WITHOUT leaning on the backrest, seen exactly from the side: we see her from her RIGHT side (she faces the viewer's right), so her right side is nearest to the viewer, feet flat on the floor, hands on her thighs. Her back is tall with a clear natural hollow in the lower back. The arrow is a curved arrow at her lower back / top of the pelvis rotating BACKWARD and down (toward the backrest), showing the pelvis rolling backward.
eind_en: END position: same side view on the same chair. Her pelvis is rolled BACKWARD (she sits on the back of her sit bones) so the LOWER back is clearly ROUNDED outward; chest and head stay roughly above the hips, feet flat.
extra_avatar: Frame both figures from the knees to the head, seen exactly from the side. Exaggerate the difference in the lower back: TOP tall with a hollow lower back, BOTTOM pelvis tilted back with a clearly rounded (convex) lower back. Only the pelvis and lower back change.

pose_en: Frame her from the hips up. She sits upright on a plain chair, seen exactly from the side: we see her from her RIGHT side (she faces the viewer's right), so her right side is nearest to the viewer, shoulders relaxed, mouth closed. Her RIGHT hand lies flat on her belly at navel height; her left hand rests on her thigh. Her belly is flat. The arrow is a short straight arrow at her belly pointing FORWARD (to the viewer's right), showing the belly moving forward as she breathes in.
eind_en: END position: same framing and side view. She has breathed IN through her nose: her belly is clearly rounded FORWARD and has pushed the right hand forward; her chest and shoulders have NOT risen.
extra_avatar: She is a slim woman with a FLAT belly (NOT pregnant). Close-up from the head to the knees, seen from the side, one hand on the belly and one on the chest. TOP: breathing out, belly flat. BOTTOM: breathing in, the belly rises only slightly forward under the hand while the chest hand stays still. Natural, non-pregnant body.
